scope: Conditional evidence from the saved M47 V2 action timeline only; archived frames are not universal deadlines.

roadblock_2.interpretation: This closes the saved roadblock-2 and safe-arrival duty, but is not proof of full-line interception or complete WIN.

artillery_counterexample.interpretation: The 5759 leak is conditional on this timeline. Recompute effective coverage, targeting contention, in-flight shells, healing and replacement from a new plan; the acceptance is observed death without leak.

mixed_pressure_counterexample.interpretation: Spot intercepted #20 while route-21 armor and route-19 armor applied overlapping ranged pressure. Replacement, healing, DP and a living blocker must be evaluated together before the first leak; a single BLOCK is not closure.

armored_34_counterexample.interpretation: 6996 is conditional on M47 V2. The new plan must provide observed death without leak; one hit or block is not duty closure.

runtime_error_causality.rule: All eight operator deaths preceded the first leak, but only four of eleven failed commands did. Later failures are not causes of the 5046 leak.

parent_preservation: Do not preserve the M47 V2 roster, 39 roadblock hits, 41 artillery hits, or positions as hard requirements; preserve only result-compatible duties supported by the chosen new structure.
GPT may replace the parent wholly or partially, but must explain which failed premise changes and which verified duty is retained or replaced.
acceptance_requirements: Use only ordinary-mode 1-3 star operators and exclude mode-specific reserve operators.
Achieve current-model WIN, zero enemy leaks, zero protected-target deaths, and both protected targets safely reached.
Medical support must arrive and heal before the next lethal hit for the patient it is intended to save.
Maintain #20/#21/#22 interception through replacement, blocking, damage and DP continuity, not a single command.
Kill the artillery and armored #34 without leaks; command emission, one BLOCK or one DAMAGE is insufficient.
Use only successful retreat refunds; account for death, blocker release, in-flight shells, redeploy cooldown, cost and successor coverage.
fixed_action_rule: Rationale and phase text do not execute conditions. The executor runs fixed frames only; do not assume conditional waiting, auto-rescue, or in-place replacement.
